text: Thank you for helping us. There are even more\nCoenubias beyond this point...
Some people seem to have fallen under the\ninfluence of the Coenubias too. Please be extra\ncareful!
Darn it! They're being controlled by the Coenubias\nindeed...
It seems that the crystals haven't done much to\nthem! If we remove them, we should be able to turn\nthem back to normal!
Alright! Instead of beating them, let's remove the\ncrystals and turn them back to normal!!
Ugh! They've been quite badly infested with the\ncrystals, it's so hard to remove them!
I think I came at the right time. Muti returned to\nErva Tronc with the news that the Rana council has\nagreed to join forces.
So I thought I should come to back you up before\nthe Eumano army. When I arrived, I saw that you\nwere in the middle of a fight...
Since the Coenubias showed up in the Rana's\nhabitat which is aquatic, I was worried that they\nmight have developed some resistance to water.
But it seems that the centrifugal force of the\nwater vortex could effectively remove the\nCoenubias from their host.
It feels great to have such a reliable ally here!\nWe haven't found the boss of the Coenubias yet,\nlet's find it!
It...it's gonna be a tough fight...
Aizen and I will stop those who are being\ncontrolled by Coenubias here. You guys go ahead!\nMake sure to defeat the ringleader!
